thread:
alice: Kickoff — running perf validation on eu-north-1 new cluster. 12 H100s provisioned. Goal: throughput + p95 baselining, kernel/driver sanity checks, NIC perf. I'll post steps and outputs as I go.

brian: Thanks — quick check: target numbers? last baseline in ga-west was ~480 tps/GPU at batch8 seq2048 and p95 ~120ms.

alice: Targets for eu-north-1: 450 tps/GPU, p95 <150ms. Also zero ECC/GPU errors and NIC >=9 Gbps on node-to-node.

carol: I'll run kernel and network checks. tagging @ops for infra knobs if needed.

opsbot: Reservation confirmed: cluster eu-north-1-h100-12 active. Reserved public IPs and subnets allocated.

alice: Step 1 — driver/kernel sanity: running `uname -r && nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name,mig_mode --format=csv`

alice: ```
$ uname -r
6.1.45-rt-h100
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name,mig_mode --format=csv
driver_version, name, mig_mode
535.113.01, NVIDIA H100-SXM, Disabled
```

brian: dmesg? any NVRM warnings about mapping or firmware? those can tank perf.

alice: clipped dmesg: ```
[    1.234567] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1f.0): 79, PID=1, 0x4c0b
[    1.235000] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0 has no errors.
```

carol: network tests — iperf3 between node-01 and node-05: 9.12 Gbits/sec. tcp window tuned.

carol: command run: `iperf3 -c 10.0.5.11 -P 4 -t 30` output snippet: ```
[SUM]   0.00-30.00  sec  9.12 Gbits/sec  1.10 GBytes
```

alice: Running model throughput runs: `python perf_runner.py --model redwood-7b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --runs 10` — summary posted below.

alice: Initial summary: avg 420 tps/GPU, p95 162ms, one node shows 380 tps. Memory usage peaked as expected ~38GB.

brian: 420 vs 450 target. Check kernel versions on all nodes — heterogenous kernels can cause scheduler differences. Also confirm MPS disabled and CUDA envs consistent.

alice: quick check: `for n in node-01 node-12; do ssh $n uname -r; done` shows node-07 at 5.15.0-101 while others on 6.1. Will reprovision node-07 to 6.1. Filed infra ticket #784.

carol: reprovisioned node-07 kernel -> 6.1.46 and rebooted. reran perf_runner on node-07 only: node-07 moved from 380 -> 460 tps. Looks like kernel mismatch was the blocker.

alice: Aggregate after fix: avg 462 tps/GPU, p95 138ms. Baseline reached. Artifacts uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-infra/eun1/perf/1765507890/ (logs, perf CSVs, iperf, dmesg).

brian: Can we add an automated check in bootstrap: fail if `uname -r` not in approved-kernels list, and check `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version` matches approved drivers. Small script: `check_kernel_and_driver.sh`.

carol: +1. I'll add kernel+driver validation to the cluster bootstrap playbook and create a checklist for handoff. Also adding an alert if p95 >200ms for newly provisioned clusters for 24h.

alice: Notes to runbook (summary): - required driver: 535.113.01 - required kernel family: 6.1.x - NIC perf expected >=9.0 Gbits - perf baseline: 450 tps/GPU @ batch8 seq2048 - common tweak: net.core.rmem_max and txqueuelen=10000 for 10Gb links - verify MPS off unless explicitly using it

deploy-bot: Canary deploy perf-fix-branch -> eu-north-1 completed. All health checks passed.

carol: I'll open PR to update runbook and close ticket #784 after merge. :thumbsup:

alice: Handoff: SRE owners @carol, perf owner @brian. If anyone observes drift >10% vs baseline, escalate to infra.

brian: Thanks — adding these checks to the perf validation checklist and creating a short postmortem note in the runbook directory. :eyes:
